subject: Discrepancy: FX conversion spike on August invoices — proposed credit schedule
messages:
From: Deepa Rao <billing@spinwell.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected FX on Aug invoices — request for adjustment

Hi Rachel,

We've been reviewing our August invoice lines and noticed a material FX-driven uplift on token charges billed in USD but converted to INR for our internal accounting. The difference between the invoice amounts and our expected local ledger is ~15% for invoice #RWI-202608-A and ~9% for #RWI-202608-B. Our accounting team flagged this as a conversion method mismatch between your dated-rate vs our bank settlement rate.

Could Redwood confirm how the exchange rate was applied on those invoices and whether you can issue a corrective credit or a ledger adjustment? We operate under an agreement that allows for invoice reissuance for material currency variances; given this is an operational conversion mismatch, we'd like a remediation plan.

Also: our AP team has TDS constraints — if Redwood issues a credit memo, we need a clear credit schedule and confirmation whether it will be net of any Indian withholding so our tax team can process the offset.

I've attached the two invoices and our remittance extract. Please let me know the next steps and an ETA for any credit issuance.

Attachments: spinwell-Aug-invoices.zip (2 PDFs, 1 CSV)

Thanks,
Deepa Rao
Head of Finance Operations
Spinwell Analytics

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Deepa Rao <billing@spinwell.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected FX on Aug invoices — request for adjustment

Hi Deepa — thanks for the clear summary and the files. We appreciate you flagging this.

Quick update from our side: Ben (billing) will run a split-ledger analysis to confirm whether the exchange rates used were system (dated) vs settlement (bank) and quantify the exposure per invoice. While we complete that, we're prepared to issue a provisional goodwill credit equal to the documented variance so your bookkeeping can proceed. This provisional credit would be applied to your outstanding balance and later replaced/confirmed by a final credit note after reconciliation.

Action items / asks:
- Ben: run ledger FX delta and propose split across the two invoices (ETA EOD 2026-09-02).
- Spinwell: confirm whether you want a single consolidated credit note or two per-invoice credits (we can do either; CC prefers one consolidated credit for AP simplicity).
- Spinwell AP: confirm whether credits should be grossed-up/issued net of TDS withholding or if you will reclaim withholding. We need this to model net impact.

I'll send a provisional credit note PDF once Ben confirms numbers. We're aiming for minimal disruption — if escrow/hold is required on your side, please tell us the account reference.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Manager
Redwood Inference

All,

I pulled the August billing batch and FX metadata. Summary: the billing pipeline stamped USD invoice lines with an internal historic daily rate (UTC close) while the customer bank settlement uses a different market rate — the net delta matches Spinwell's reported percentages: ~15% and ~9%.

Proposed corrective approach:
1) Issue a provisional consolidated credit of $28,450 USD (calculated delta) to be applied against account balance now (provisional-credit-note-Spinwell-0902.pdf attached).
2) Reissue corrected invoice PDFs showing adjusted USD totals and a line item referencing the credit memo (we will not change original invoice numbers; instead we'll attach corrected copies for Spinwell's archive).
3) If Spinwell confirms they will withhold TDS at source, we'll issue the credit net of TDS only after we receive formal remittance withholding documentation from Spinwell's AP (Form 16 equivalent). Otherwise, credits will be gross and Spinwell can apply for reclaim per local rules.
4) Accounting impact: Laura, recommend booking provisional credit to 'Allowance for Billing Adjustments' (GL 4503) and hold an anticipatory tax entry if TDS withheld. Logan, please confirm cash-application flow for the affected invoices so collections aren't disturbed.

Costs/recon: attaching quick ledger extract for visibility (ledger-fx-delta-0902.csv).

Ben
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional-credit-note-Spinwell-0902.pdf, ledger-fx-delta-0902.csv
